text:
Maria (partnerships): Kickoff: cloud marketplace onboarding for new publisher. Need to confirm image naming, SKU mapping, trial flow, and who owns the EULA link. Quick sync here so we can send partner checklist.
Alex (partner-ops): Do we want separate SKUs per region or a single global SKU with regional pricing? Partner asks for volume discounts too.
Nora (eng-cloud): Recommend separate SKU per region for visibility into activations. Images: AWS x86_64 + arm64 AMIs, GCP images for us-central1 + europe-west1, and a single Azure managed image.
Sam (marketing): I'll supply the storefront blurb + 3 screenshots. Need exact pixel sizes and one square logo plus favicon (16x16). Who owns the hero copy?
Maria (partnerships): Partnerships will own hero copy draft. Sam, please deliver assets by EOD so we can upload to staging.
Oliver (legal): For Azure private offers and AWS marketplace we must provide a hosted EULA and a DPA link. We host both on our docs site; need versioned URL and a contact name on the EULA. Also, confirm the trial terms (duration and data retention).
Maria (partnerships): Proposed trial: 14-day entitlement that maps to a trial SKU in the marketplace. After trial ends, customer is moved to paid plan unless they opt out. Any objections?
Alex (partner-ops): That flow works. Partner wanted a meter-based option for larger customers; we can enable metered in a follow-up.
Nora (eng-cloud): On infra: create a publisher automation role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-publisher-automation. Will push Terraform snippet to repo. The role will have least-privilege: ec2:DescribeImages, marketplace:PublishImage, billing:ReadMetrics.
Maria (partnerships): Please paste the Terraform snippet here so partners can test.
Nora (eng-cloud): Snippet:
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "publisher_automation" {
  name = "redwood-publisher-automation"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.trust.json
}
```
Nora (eng-cloud): PR with AMI build parity checks: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/cloud-images/pull/83
CI-bot: image-build pipeline succeeded -> 1750101150 (staging).
Sam (marketing): delivering assets: hero.png (1600x600), storefront-thumb.png (640x360), screenshots.zip. Uploading to drive now.
Oliver (legal): I'll add a short trial/data retention paragraph and publish as docs.redwood.ai/legal/eula/v1.2. Will include signer "Redwood, Inc. Legal" and timestamp.
Maria (partnerships): Timeline: staging listing ready Thu EOD, legal sign-off Fri, partner QA next Mon, public in ~2 weeks. Call tomorrow 9am PT to walk partner through the manifest.
Alex (partner-ops): Blockers: partner procurement negotiating 45-day payment window for marketplace payouts. We need escalation to finance if they push.
Nora (eng-cloud): Blocker for me: need QA to approve AMI parity script. Pinged QA.
Maria (partnerships): Action items: 1) @Nora push Terraform + ARN in PR (link above), 2) @Sam upload assets and hero copy, 3) @Oliver publish EULA URL v1.2 and confirm DPA link, 4) Partnerships to create the partner checklist and schedule tomorrow's call.
Sam (marketing): noted, will finish assets and copy by today.
Oliver (legal): noted, I'll post the EULA URL once live.
Maria (partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll DM partner with the call invite and attach the manifest when ready. :rocket:
